== Summary ==
Photograph of page 79 of ''[[InQuest]]'' #43 (November 1998): a proposal that Star Wars CCG add a 12-card "Toolkit Deck" for magic-bullet cards. The same poster shared other pages of the issue the next day ([[:File:InQuest 43 Star Wars CCG pages.pdf]]).
